title: NOAA Storm Event Record
description: Schema for NOAA Storm Events Database records covering significant weather events and their impacts on life and property

event_id.description: Unique identifier for the storm event record

episode_id.description: NOAA episode identifier grouping related storm events in a single meteorological episode

event_type.description: Classified type of the storm or severe weather event

state.description: Two-letter state abbreviation where the event occurred

state_fips.description: Two-digit FIPS code for the state where the event occurred

county_fips.description: Five-digit FIPS code (state + county) for the county where the event occurred

begin_date.description: Date and time when the storm event began

end_date.description: Date and time when the storm event ended

injuries_direct.description: Number of injuries directly caused by the storm event

injuries_indirect.description: Number of injuries indirectly caused by the storm event

deaths_direct.description: Number of fatalities directly caused by the storm event

deaths_indirect.description: Number of fatalities indirectly caused by the storm event

magnitude.description: Measured or estimated magnitude of the event (e.g., wind speed, hail size)

magnitude_type.description: Unit or scale used to express the event magnitude

begin_lat.description: Latitude of the event's starting location in decimal degrees

begin_lon.description: Longitude of the event's starting location in decimal degrees

end_lat.description: Latitude of the event's ending location in decimal degrees

end_lon.description: Longitude of the event's ending location in decimal degrees

tor_f_scale.description: Enhanced Fujita scale rating for tornado events

source.description: Reporting source that submitted or verified the event (e.g., NWS, trained spotter, law enforcement)

flood_cause.description: Primary cause of flooding for flood and flash flood events (e.g., heavy rain, dam failure, ice jam)

load_time.description: Timestamp when the record was loaded into the data platform

_ingested_at.description: Timestamp when the record was ingested by the pipeline

_source.description: Source system or API endpoint that provided the record

_batch_id.description: Batch identifier for the ingestion run that produced this record
